name: Siargao Surf & Island Escape
description: Three days of surf, lagoons, and island hopping across Siargao's highlights. Ride the Cloud 9 boardwalk, paddle through Sugba Lagoon, and unwind on Magpupungko's rock pools.

name: Siargao Adventure Trail
description: Five immersive days on Siargao — surf sessions, cave pools, mangrove kayaking, and the island's best hidden beaches for travelers who want the full experience.

name: Dinagat Island Hopping
description: A weekend of turquoise coves, limestone cliffs, and secluded white-sand beaches. Hop between Cab-ilan and Bita-og with a local boatman and guide.

name: Dinagat Hidden Coves Escape
description: Four days exploring the lesser-known coves and sandbars of Dinagat, with overnight stays near the beach and sunset cruises around the archipelago.

name: Agusan Marsh River Safari
description: A guided day trip through the floating village, wetlands, and birdwatching hotspots of Agusan Marsh — a serene journey into one of the Philippines' largest wetland sanctuaries.

name: Agusan Marsh & Culture Stay
description: Two days on the marsh — river safari on day one, an overnight at a floating village, and a cultural exchange with the Manobo community on day two.

name: Tinuy-an Falls & Enchanted River
description: Visit the curtain-like Tinuy-an Falls and the famously blue Enchanted River in Hinatuan, with jungle treks and swimming stops along the way.

name: Butuan Heritage River Cruise
description: A day discovering Butuan's ancient balangay boats, regional museum, and a relaxing sunset cruise along the historic Agusan River.
